linux.notes: AUDIT 10 (matched to review): headerbar-subtitle 41 and actionbar 14 flat px off (Light and Dark), up to 207 levels: the header bar icons (menu, minimise, maximise, add) are smaller and shaped differently from GTK's (seen in the side-by-side). | Compared with scripts/linux_cmp_l3.py (strict: a reference pixel flat in its 3 x 3 neighbourhood is off when ours differs by more than 2 levels; only glyph pixels within 2 px of text or icon ink are left out). Both captured states have a cell: the header bar with a subtitle (the library's capture includes its three window controls, which the sheet draws as 24 px circles) and the action bar. 25228 flat reference pixels, 0 off; no pixel outside the masked text and icons differs by more than 2 levels. The status bar is GtkActionBar (headerbar colour, 1 px line, 32 high, 6 px padding); the header bar is AdwHeaderBar (47 high, 34 px buttons, a bold centred title with a 55 % subtitle).
gaps: Glyphs (add, menu, window controls) are Neper's own strokes, thinner than the icon theme's; they are masked
Progress items, glyph items, tones and pressable panels of the status bar are not captured; they keep the Material layout with these colours
The window controls are drawn by the sheet, not by window.e (which has its own 36 high Linux caption)
Not verified at 150 %

linux.notes: AUDIT 10 (matched to review): adw-tabbar 64, adw-viewswitcher 105 (Light; 3 Dark), notebook top 11 and left 4 flat px off glyphs excluded, up to 200 levels: tab icons and close marks. | Compared with scripts/linux_cmp_l3.py (strict: a reference pixel flat in its 3 x 3 neighbourhood is off when ours differs by more than 2 levels; only glyph pixels within 2 px of text or icon ink are left out). All four captured states have a cell: the notebook with its tabs on top and on the left (a 1 px frame, the tab header the control builds and the page), an AdwTabBar over its page (chosen tab with its close button and the scrolled strip's edge fade, a separator between the others) and an AdwViewSwitcher. 109914 flat reference pixels, 0 off; 30 non-flat pixels differ (the switcher's 6 px corners).
gaps: The tab bar's and view switcher's tab positions are passed in (lefts and widths measured on the capture); libadwaita's expand-tabs rules are not reproduced
The tab bar's fade is a clipped-strip artefact of the capture (the first tab is partly scrolled out) drawn as a 36 px gradient; a tab bar at rest has none

Hover and pressed tabs follow the stylesheet (washes 7 % and 16 %, the 15 % bar on a notebook tab) but the library's crops have no such state; close-button hover, overflow arrows, drag indicator and the switcher's narrow policy are not built
View switcher pictures are Neper's Picture glyph standing for the library's missing-image icon; masked
Cantarell is hinted by GTK and not by Neper, so glyph pixels differ; they are masked, everything else is not.
Not verified at 150 %
